pretraining: Existing strong shared-DeMo50 E37 private5120 plus extra50; inherited baseline gain separated from adaptation and experts

anchor.method: AE normal MSVR310 only. Strong shared-DeMo50 teacher private5120 initialization, then additional50/newAdam and fixed five outlet epochs plus45 limited generalFusion epochs at .1LR. Axis frozen50 separates stage adaptation from stronger initialization; staged ordinary/axis have identical data/order/augmentation/budget/heads/loss/parameters. Staged noexpert DeMo has the same private5120 interface, teacher, full/main/base objectives, stages and705 updates but no M/F/route/projection/auxiliary objectives; parameter/compute differences disclosed. Original BACKBONE/three reducers and all core eval modes/GF buffers fixed. One optimizer/scheduler with GF groups registered initially, no GF gradient/state/weight-decay during outlet phase; no optimizer reset/addgroups at epoch6. Native staged smoke explicitly one successful outlet step then two relation steps, not five trained epochs. Full1032train591Q1055G/noholdout/benchmarkmAP-best earliestties/all6 sameweight/CMC/perquery/groups/curves/best-last/fourstate net gain. Strong private47.763/65.482 differs from full563249.426/69.036 and both are inherited baseline scores, not added-expert gain. Currentbase00 changes after stage2; cap.10 is not a teacher-drift bound. KeepY mean512/MFaux.001/mainCE.05/reg0/hinge.6/P16K4/BN2/partial0/two backwards. No new public block/local regions/FFT/loss/201NN/49/missingdesign/seedhunt.
anchor.limits: Common context remains auxiliary; coupled gate is not claimed calibrated. Twelve disjoint-source cases lack shared identity coordinates; missing evaluation deferred.

final_unit_descriptor_bound.placement: After complete parent M/F/I aggregation, gates and relation weights; before final deployed return
final_unit_descriptor_bound.inactive_output: Exact original candidate bytes; 00 remains the existing frozen identity path
final_unit_descriptor_bound.limits: Known norm bound; not retrieval correctness or guaranteed +1. K PI10/01 native equality is checked before this new output bound.

anchor.contribution_reference: Stopped-gradient corresponding gallery state; fixed00 positive/negative indices

M_F_auxiliary_outlet.current: Actual first11 projected per-relation unit directions, uniform relation mean512
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.auxiliary_dtype: FP32 deployed directions; previous raw pools under native AMP
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.pooling_domain: Uniform mean over seven actual projected relation directions; old independent auxiliary pool_score weights frozen because only stopped controlled targets still use them
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.inference: Hooks/pool replacement inactive in eval; original5120 graph

strong_teacher.private_reference: Same teacher private5120 block, not its full5632 .75/.25 score
strong_teacher.limits: Full teacher49.426/69.036 is an existing baseline, not this5120 student score or expert gain. Warm private reference47.763432/65.482234 must be independently reloaded/checked before training. Only warm initialization changes from Y; no gradual unfreezing is implemented here.

staged_adaptation.native: Staged smoke: one successful outlet update then two relation updates; not five mature epochs
staged_adaptation.scope: Outlet stage also updates existing auxiliary heads/shared projection; not an exact linear probe. 00 after relation adaptation differs from the teacher; cap.10 bounds current base-to-final only. Noexpert control has fewer parameters and no M/F computation. Ordinary/axis staged counts match. Strong private initialization is inherited baseline ability, not expert gain.

checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
